# `network/realm/link/TransportProvider.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/link/TransportProvider.js`

Realm transport providers adapt existing channels. They do not implement WebRTC, relays, WebSockets, LAN sockets, or encryption themselves.

## Functions

Validate the minimal bidirectional channel RealmLink consumes.
